<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="T_Txx3Xaxb4ICrfqFrLV"> <mxGraphModel dx="857" dy="-603" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
skinparam actorStyle awesome
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam usecase {
 BackgroundColor #EFFFEF
 BorderColor #22a06b
 FontColor #1A2235
 FontSize 11
}
skinparam actor {
 BackgroundColor #C8F0DC
 BorderColor #22a06b
 FontColor #1A2235
 FontSize 12
 FontStyle bold
}
skinparam package {
 BackgroundColor #F6FFF9
 BorderColor #7DDBB0
 FontColor #1A2235
 FontStyle bold
}
skinparam arrow {
 Color #22a06b
 FontColor #22a06b
 FontSize 10
}

left to right direction

actor \"Teacher\" as Teacher #PaleGreen

rectangle \"AI-Driven Smart LMS — Teacher Portal\" {

 package \"Authentication\" {
 usecase \"Login\" as UC_Login
 usecase \"Update Profile\" as UC_Profile
 }

 package \"Course Management\" {
 usecase \"View Assigned\nCourses\" as UC_Courses
 usecase \"View Enrolled\nStudents\" as UC_Students
 }

 package \"Attendance Management\" {
 usecase \"Create Lecture\nSession\" as UC_Session
 usecase \"Mark Bulk\nAttendance\" as UC_MarkAtt
 usecase \"View Attendance\nReport\" as UC_AttRpt
 usecase \"View Short\nAttendance Students\" as UC_Short
 }

 package \"Assessment Management\" {
 usecase \"Create / Manage\nAssignments\" as UC_Assign
 usecase \"Grade Student\nSubmissions\" as UC_Grade
 usecase \"Run Plagiarism\nCheck\" as UC_Plag
 usecase \"Create / Manage\nQuizzes\" as UC_Quiz
 usecase \"Generate AI Quiz\n(Gemini)\" as UC_AIQuiz
 usecase \"Create Exam &\nEnter Results\" as UC_Exam
 }

 package \"Analytics & Reports\" {
 usecase \"View Class\nLeaderboard\" as UC_Leader
 usecase \"View At-Risk\nStudents\" as UC_AtRisk
 usecase \"Calculate Student\nAnalytics\" as UC_Calc
 }

 package \"Communication\" {
 usecase \"View Announcements\n& Notices\" as UC_Ann
 usecase \"Manage Course\nChat Group\" as UC_Chat
 }
}

' ── Associations ─────────────────────────────────
Teacher --> UC_Login
Teacher --> UC_Profile

Teacher --> UC_Courses
Teacher --> UC_Students

Teacher --> UC_Session
Teacher --> UC_MarkAtt
Teacher --> UC_AttRpt
Teacher --> UC_Short

Teacher --> UC_Assign
Teacher --> UC_Grade
Teacher --> UC_Plag
Teacher --> UC_Quiz
Teacher --> UC_AIQuiz
Teacher --> UC_Exam

Teacher --> UC_Leader
Teacher --> UC_AtRisk
Teacher --> UC_Calc

Teacher --> UC_Ann
Teacher --> UC_Chat

' ── Include / Extend ─────────────────────────────
UC_MarkAtt .> UC_Session : <<include>>
UC_AIQuiz .> UC_Quiz : <<extend>>
UC_Plag .> UC_Grade : <<extend>>
UC_AtRisk .> UC_Leader : <<extend>>

@enduml",
 "format": "svg"
